description: The propositional reading of a relational matrix preserves falsity and implication and treats each whole relation application, including its actual term arguments, as one atom.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.propositionalize.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} {n : ℕ} :
  L.BoundedFormula α n →
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Atom L (α ⊕ Fin n))
